connection_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SAF.InteractionGroup_Id,Found_Hybrid_Key_Match  ORDER BY SAF.SequenceStart_It,SAF.LoadEvent_Id ASC) AS ROW_NUM,
CASE WHEN FND.InteractionGroup_Id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS Found_Hybrid_Key_Match,
SAF.BaseInteractionGroup_Id, 
SAF.InteractionGroup_Id, 
SAF.Effective_Dt, 
SAF.Expiration_Dt, 
SAF.Transaction_Ts, 
SAF.Revision_Ts, 
SAF.SequenceStart_It, 
SAF.SequenceEnd_It, 
SAF.Source_Cd, 
SAF.Chksum_BaseInteractionGroup, 
SAF.LoadFlag_BaseInteractionGroup 
FROM
	$$interaction_work_db.SAF_BaseInteractionGroup SAF 
LEFT OUTER JOIN
	$$interaction_fnd_db.BaseInteractionGroup FND
ON 	
	SAF.InteractionGroup_Id=FND.InteractionGroup_Id 
    AND SAF.Source_Cd=FND.Source_Cd
	AND SAF.SequenceStart_It=FND.SequenceStart_It

connection_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT	
InteractionGroup_Id,						
MAX(KeepSequence_It) OVER   (PARTITION BY InteractionGroup_Id ORDER	BY SequenceStart_It,LoadEvent_Id ASC
     												 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
Effective_Dt,
MAX(KeepLoadEvent_It) OVER (PARTITION BY InteractionGroup_Id ORDER BY SequenceStart_It,LoadEvent_Id ASC
     												 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
FROM(
		SELECT
            InteractionGroup_Id,
			SequenceStart_It,
			Effective_Dt,
			Rank_It,
			LoadEvent_Id,
			COALESCE(Rank_It - SUM(Rank_It) OVER (PARTITION BY  InteractionGroup_Id ORDER	BY  SequenceStart_It,LoadEvent_Id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND	1 PRECEDING),Rank_It) 	AS Rank_Diff,
			CASE WHEN	Rank_Diff <> 0 THEN SequenceStart_It END AS KeepSequence_It,
			CASE WHEN	Rank_Diff <> 0 THEN LoadEvent_Id END AS KeepLoadEvent_It
		FROM(
					SELECT
                        InteractionGroup_Id,
						SequenceStart_It,
						Effective_Dt,
						LoadEvent_Id,
						RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY  InteractionGroup_Id ORDER	BY Chksum_BaseInteractionGroup) AS Rank_It
					FROM $$interaction_work_db.saf_baseinteractiongroup WHERE LoadFlag_BaseInteractionGroup <>'I'

			 ) rankbaseinteractiongroup
	)ranksequence

connection_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT
O.BaseInteractionGroup_Id,
O.InteractionGroup_Id,
O.Source_Cd,
O.NewExpiration_Dt,
O.NewRevision_Ts,
O.NewSequenceEnd_It
FROM
(
SELECT BaseInteractionGroup_Id,
       InteractionGroup_Id,
       Source_Cd,
       COALESCE (
          MIN (
             Effective_Dt)
          OVER (PARTITION BY InteractionGroup_Id
                ORDER BY Effective_Dt ASC, SequenceStart_It ASC
                ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),
          DATE '3500-01-01')
          AS NewExpiration_Dt,
       COALESCE (
          MIN (
             Transaction_Ts)
          OVER (PARTITION BY InteractionGroup_Id
                ORDER BY Transaction_Ts ASC, SequenceStart_It ASC
                ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),
          TIMESTAMP '3500-01-01 00:00:00.000000')
          AS NewRevision_Ts,
       COALESCE (
          MIN (
             SequenceStart_It)
          OVER (PARTITION BY InteractionGroup_Id
                ORDER BY SequenceStart_It ASC
                ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),
          350036535003659999)
          AS NewSequenceEnd_It
  FROM $$interaction_fnd_db.BaseInteractionGroup tgt
 WHERE EXISTS
          (SELECT 1
             FROM $$interaction_work_db.Saf_BaseInteractionGroup tgt1
            WHERE     tgt.InteractionGroup_Id = tgt1.InteractionGroup_Id
                  AND tgt.Source_Cd = tgt1.Source_Cd)
QUALIFY NOT (Expiration_Dt  = NewExpiration_Dt
        AND  Revision_Ts    = NewRevision_Ts
        AND  SequenceEnd_It = NewSequenceEnd_It))O
